intro: The Cache of Zanzil's Altered Mixture is a stockpile of potent poison secured inside a locked chest at the Venture Company tower near the Sludge Fen. Named for the jungle troll witch doctor Zanzil, it serves as a critical target for the Shattered Hand in Orgrimmar.

p: North of the Sludge Fen in the Barrens, the Venture Company keeps a tower outpost. A cache of an altered mixture bearing the name of the infamous troll witch doctor Zanzil sits locked inside Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix's private strongbox at the summit of the tower. A poison has weakened everything in the tower, leaving its goblin inhabitants vulnerable to any intruder bold enough to strike.
